title: Converger activity (client API shape)
description: An activity as returned by the Converger client API (`GET /api/v1/converger/conversations/ID/activities`, `activitySet` frames on /socket/converger) and accepted, without the server fields, by `POST .../activities`. See docs/concepts/activities.md. The activity type vocabulary is closed: an unknown `type` is rejected with 422. Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields.

text.description: Message text. For `messageReaction` the emoji (null or empty: the reaction was removed); for `messageUpdate` the new text.

timestamp.description: Server time of the insert, ISO 8601 UTC.

channelData.description: The activity metadata (at most 16 KiB as JSON).

replyToId.description: The activity this one refers to, in the same conversation: a threaded reply for `message`; the target (required, a `message`) for `messageReaction`, `messageUpdate` and `messageDelete`.

editedAt.description: Set on the original when a `messageUpdate` for it was accepted. The original's content is unchanged; clients apply the update.

deletedAt.description: Set on the original when a `messageDelete` for it was accepted. Clients hide the original.

activityType.description: Converger's activity vocabulary. `deliveryReceipt` is internal: servers may emit it, clients cannot create it.

attachment.description: An attachment descriptor as accepted on write (at most 4 KiB as JSON). Unknown keys are dropped; provider-specific fields belong in `channelData`.

contentType.description: A MIME type, or a well-known Converger type: `application/vnd.converger.card.*` (requires an object `content`), `application/vnd.converger.location`, `application/vnd.converger.contacts`.

channelData.description: Provider passthrough, for example a WhatsApp media id.

storedAttachment.description: Attachments are returned as stored. Attachments written before the attachment schema existed may lack `contentType`.

url.description: An absolute http(s) URL or a server path such as /api/v1/converger/attachments/ID.
